reviews.comment: Professor Joey is by far the best professor I've had at A&M, I wholeheartedly support everyone who wants to take his classes (please do it). He's kind, patient and will even push back assignments if you're having issues. If you have the option to learn from him, take the opportunity, you won't regret it

Great prof!! He goes on a lot of tangents during class, but honestly, it made me learn so much more and he is hilarious. He is very understanding and gives students so much time for assignments and really cares. I learned a lot and really enjoyed this course. HW is mainly short video assignments each week and two blogs, which are not bad at all!
This may be the best and easiest professor I've ever had. Only had maybe 7 things graded no exams and no quizzes easy grader and very lenient when you are late with an assignment.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Joey is the best. Really nice guy, wants us to succeed, and tells us how to succeed. Definitely recommend taking his class if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Joey is the best professor I've ever had. He's kind and understanding and shares real-life stories that make class meaningful. His class gives you freedom to be creative and think in new ways. He listens, supports you, and helps you grow. If you get the chance to take his class, do it, you won't regret it. TRUST ME!!

Easy class only 2 grades, a mid term and final blog. Attendance is required for a grade also. Only thing I didnt like is that he brings up politics a lot and he lets you know his side. Its easy but just something to note, but its what to expect from a culture class.
Pretty easy class. His grading is 2 projects and attendance. No test/homework, just have to go to class. Would take again...

Very easy prof for a writing intensive course, a little bit all over the place with assignments and often lectures about random things that don't pertain to the course AT ALL, but overall I would definitely recommend for an easy writing intensive credit, easy A.
BEST PROF @ A&M!!! Take him if you can!!! Attendance is mandatory but he makes the class fun and easy. No exams just 2 blogs!

joey=the best, gr8 lecturer and "takes attendance" but doesn't actually. been to lecture like once a term just to hear him speak because he is super cool 340 only has a midterm and a final so if you mess up you are kinda screwed but its hard to get a bad grade since joey is an easy grader, just wants to see creativity and effort even if its minimal

Joey was an amazing Professor. He's very laid back and really enjoys his job. The class grade is based on 2 blogs. Start working on them 2 weeks before they're due and you'll do great! I really recommend him and I wish I could have him as a professor every semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Joey is the most genuine professor I've ever had. It's a smaller class so he wants us to get to know him- criteria wise it's an interesting class. he takes attendance, there's a few in-class activities scattered about and 3 main projects. no exams. he's very chill if you have to miss class and he's very reachable via email. love him!!

As an anxious person, this was the best possible speech class I could have taken. He makes an effort not to judge you off of a list of requirements but off of your personal growth. I've already found the lessons taught in this class improve my experiences elsewhere in my college career. Great guy, and I hope to stay in contact with him.
Can't say I learned anything but I had a good time. Dr. Lopez is very lighthearted, understanding, and wants everyone to do well. Had some fun making goofy projects.

I have never written a review on rate my professor, but I feel like I have to for Professor Joey. He is the best professor I have had in my entire college career. He is so passionate about popular culture and his lectures are always entertaining. He is extremely kind and understanding and cares for his students. Please take him.

Prof. Lopez was great! He's easy to talk to, and the lectures are interesting. The class is super easy, just participation in the class assignments (which are fun) and 3 projects in which you can do anything you want. He's super fun and as long as you try you can easily get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He's so chill and an easy grader. You get to do a bunch of fun stuff in his class with hardly any boundaries

I took Professor Lopez in a summer session and it was a great class! He's extremely kind and wants everyone to enjoy the topics he's teaching about. Participate in the assignments (they're all easy and enjoyable) and it's an easy A! Couldn't recommend him enough!

If you are only looking for an easy A, this class is for you. Only have to complete two projects and show up to the lectures. Prof. Lopez is a really cool guy who is very passionate about what he is teaching. The only bad thing is that I felt that I did not really learn anything from this class, but it was still a lot of fun.

Take him for COMM 340! All you have to do is show up & complete 2 projects that he grades very kindly on. The lectures are interesting & informative; you can tell he really likes what he teaches. He is very caring & respectful towards his students, but it makes him sad when people don't participate. Honestly such a pure-hearted person.

Dr. Lopez is a funny guy and an awesome professor. His knowledge of social media and the internet is unmatched. His class was easy but informative. This class is needed for the social media certificate, and Joey is the best option for the introductory course. I would recommend him regardless, but he is the best option for COMM275.

This was my second time taking a class with Joey and I've thoroughly enjoyed both of them! He cares about the content that he's teaching, wants his students to be passionate about it too, and focuses more on facilitating discussion that will leave an impact rather than making us do pointless assignments. I would take his classes again and again!

Joey is an incredible professor whose classes I have taken twice. He fits my learning style well because he is NOT about memorization or getting through the course just because it has to be done. He engages people in meaningful conversations and is always looking for ways to help students improve in media. If you can, definitely take his classes!
Fun and is not a hard grader.

Attendance is part of your grade, so you have to go to class. There are only two grades  a midterm and final video project, both of which are very easy. Lectures are normally pretty interesting  he just talks as if he talking to a friend which makes it easy to pay attention.
Joey is a really nice person and cares about his students! The only downfall was that the class was unstructured-- and that's how he likes things. Easy prof and easy class. Attendance is required.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took Joey for 230/410 this past semester and really enjoyed both classes. He was very helpful, caring, and a really great prof. He really lets you experiment with the projects alot and gives good feedback for future projects. I really had a great time in his class and it sucks I can't take more classes with him. He's a real gem for Comm. 10/10.

Joey is a very considerate, caring, and hilarious professor. His grading is project based so it is really on you if you want to succeed. His projects are designed to inspire you to challenge yourself and rising to meet this guarantees you to do well in his class. I found his course to be encompassing, entertaining, and inspirational. A must take.

I'm not going to lie, I did not learn much in this class, but Joey was cool. Our Zoom classes were mostly him showing us stuff and then us talking about it. The two projects were really cool; they were just blog posts. Very chill class. The only thing is that he's not very good about responding to emails.

I LOVE this professor. He's so understanding and makes the class so enjoyable, even though we cannot meet in person :(. I respect Professor Joey Lopez so much for making me want to learn and pay attention, which is something I don't easily do. Thank you, professor Lopez!!

He is honestly a very caring professor. He is very accessible outside of class. He grades video projects within 24 hours. I learned a lot in the class. He assigns videos to watch that correlate with the textbook readings. I did not read all chapters. Don't stress over the videos because as long as you try you will do good. This is an easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great prof and an easy class if you just show effort in projects! He takes attendance every class and you do projects so you can't skip. I thought some of the lectures were interesting and he gave us lots of creative freedom with the 3 graded projects.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Joey is the GOAT. The worst part about his class is mandatory attendance with no unexcused absences tolerated. Other than that, it's insanely difficult not to get an A in his class. He cares about you really learning the material and focusing on your passions. Take Joey if you get the chance!!! Easy class that isn't painful to attend.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Joey was a great professor. His classes were always fun to go to while making video projects. He is very understanding and sweet. He does a lot of group project in class, and give you lots of time to finish them. There is a sign-in sheet so do not miss class unless you email him otherwise.

Wonderful prof! Easy A and great class to edify your view of the world and the internet. Dr. Lopez excels at encouraging his students to pursue their unique academic goals and promoting discussion in class. Very few but major projects, nothing hard. Engage in discussion, check out the cool stuff he recommends and go to class, you should get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love this prof. He's really laid back and is much more concerned with just letting students get what they want out of the class. I personally didn't LEARN much from the prof, but I did enjoy the class and was able to expand on my passion for video making. You'll get an A, but you can get more out of it if you want to.

He's an easy A but he taught me ABSOLUTELY nothing. EVERY class he showed us his boring social media, didn't really teach, cracked bad jokes, talked about himself like he was GOAT. He is laid back, but in a bad way. not well prepared. easy but useless. you could learn more about video work in a ten minute youtube video. Kinda cocky. Terrible
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Joey is a very laid back professor. He is passionate about what he teaches and has experience in the field. He does require you to come to class and does assign small group projects but they're mostly just for fun and to learn about the software. His grades consist of indv. projects, but as long as you put some effort you'll be fine. Good Class!
